d:
In the bustling and lively steampunk Dukedom city of Lindblum, built safely upon the Lindblum Plateau, the Industrial District is home to the Doom Pub.

The pub monikered as such because it has always attracted all kind of low-lives from all around the Dukedom.

Already successfull financially, the pub has reached a new peak since the long-braided waitress made her appearance time ago, charming the patrons with her beauty and mannerisms.

The pub owner enjoying the coins being cashed-in and the patrons relishing on tasty but cheap grog, the long-braided waitress keeps the pretense going on, until she...
